findings.text: LatinIME delegates onCreateInputView to KeyboardSwitcher. The latter inflates R.layout.input_view, assigns its keyboard/frame/emoji children, initializes them and returns mCurrentInputView. Neither reviewed method has an explicit return-null or catch-and-return-empty fallback. Inflate/resource/cast failures are not converted to a successful null view here. This is not proof that the on-device implementation ran or a child obtained positive geometry.

findings.text: These early exits abort initialization; they do not explicitly set an empty or null input view. Base IMS callback flags alone cannot prove this subclass completed its keyboard load.

loadKeyboard constructs a layout set and catches KeyboardLayoutSetException from the load-state path, logging loading keyboard failed. The reviewed catch does not install a replacement keyboard or prove whether old/null content remains. No such runtime exception is established by this review.

setMainKeyboardFrame chooses GONE for the keyboard and its frame under this condition; it also hides the emoji palettes. LatinIME additional helper requires !onEvaluateInputViewShown(). The IMMS/base-IMS dump does not independently expose this LatinIME settings cache or toggleState, so Configuration or SettingsObserver alone does not establish this branch.

findings.text: getVisibleKeyboardView chooses shown emoji palettes, otherwise the main keyboard. Its name alone is not a visibility assertion. The later dump cannot identify which early-return branch ran without the unobserved subclass state.

findings.condition: visibleKeyboardView.isShown() gates switching touchableInsets to TOUCHABLE_INSETS_REGION and setting the rectangle.
findings.text: Even after this branch, nonpositive width or bottom<=top gives an empty rectangle. If the child is not shown, this branch does not replace the superclass touchable mode/region. IMS mInputViewStarted/mIsInputViewShown are not measurements of this child width, height or isShown. No on-device zero geometry has yet been observed.

The reviewed InputView class is a FrameLayout focused on child references and input-event forwarding; it has no onMeasure/onLayout override or explicit zero-size path. LatinIME expands its input root/area to MATCH_PARENT outside fullscreen and uses WRAP_CONTENT in fullscreen. The layout XML, geometry resource helpers and MainKeyboardView are outside the frozen three-file scope, so no conclusion about their positive dimensions or rendering follows.

boundedConclusions.conclusion: Yes, LatinIME overrides onEvaluateInputViewShown. It returns true only when its private mIsExecutingStartShowingInputView flag is true; otherwise it returns super.onEvaluateInputViewShown(). The startShowingInputView helper sets that flag around showWindow(true). No unconditional LatinIME bypass of the framework predicate exists in these fixed lines.

This precisely matches a source condition capable of keeping the input area hidden despite show requested.

boundedConclusions.conclusion: The measured mInputViewStarted=true and mViewsCreated=true do not contradict mIsInputViewShown=false. Fixed startViews/doStartInput set the started flag and invoke the callback from show-request state without requiring mIsInputViewShown=true. mViewsCreated is set in the candidate-view setup path. updateInputViewShown creates the input view inside its changed-visibility branch; if false stays false, that branch need not run. LatinIME can also return early when its main keyboard view is null.
boundedConclusions.limit: The observation does not independently prove mInputView==null, which callback returned early, or actual keyboard child geometry.

boundedConclusions.conclusion: The later dump records VISIBLE mode (2), contentTopInsets=visibleTopInsets=616 and empty IMS cached touchableRegion. LatinIME replaces the mode with REGION only in a shown-child branch; its early returns can retain superclass mode/region. Thus these values are consistent with an unshown or unavailable child, but do not select a specific branch. Empty IMS region in VISIBLE mode is not a final WMS/SF region measurement.

boundedConclusions.conclusion: The preserved suffix prints Keyboard mode=-1. Fixed LatinIME.dump prints keyboard.mId.mMode when a Keyboard exists and -1 otherwise. This is a different value from KeyboardSwitcher.KeyboardSwitchState.HIDDEN; the shared numeric -1 does not equate the two. getKeyboard returns null when mKeyboardView is null or its own keyboard is null.
